title: carum intermedium
intro: Carum intermedium, commonly known as Ajwain, is a small annual plant belonging to the Apiaceae family, native to the Middle East and India. The health benefits of Ajwain include its use as a digestive aid, helping to relieve symptoms of indigestion, nausea, and diarrhea, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which can help to combat bacterial infections. Therapeutically, Ajwain is used to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, while its anti-inflammatory properties make it effective in reducing pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of Ajwain include compounds like thymol, borneol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
